resources.string: Usage: lib <name> (type libs for the list)

#Run run::Run the open file stop::Stop the running program (^C) clear::Clear the screen #Session history::Previous commands (!! last, !N number N) session::Names declared in this session reset::Forget the session declarations #Search and share grep ::Search the screen goto ::Jump to line n in the editor ocr ::Print the text inside an image copy · share::Copy or share the whole screen #Files pwd::Project folder path ls [-a] [dir]::List files tree [dir]::Folder tree cat ::Show a file with line numbers alias n=cmd::Define a shortcut (alias to list) unalias ::Remove a shortcut #Info banner::Show the Rin logo about::Versions and system info version::Engine version libs::List built-in libraries lib ::Library card colors::ANSI color sample #Display background::Image or space (space · stop · play · clear · dim N) theme [name]::Color theme (theme to list) size ::Font preset xs…xxl spacing ::Line spacing tight/normal/relaxed style::Current style settings fullscreen · ⛶::Full-screen terminal font +/-/N::Font size echo ::Print text (supports \e[..m)
Anything else runs as Rin code, e.g. let x = 5; then x * 2.\nTab completes, ↑/↓ browse history, pinch to zoom. ^C cancels input.
Usage: background [space | stop | play | clear | dim 0-90]
Space background on — background stop to freeze, background clear to remove
Stars frozen — background play to resume
Enable the space background first: background space
